description: NaPrZrTiO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.82 Å. Pr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. All Pr-O bond lengths are 2.82 Å. Zr is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Zr-O bond lengths are 2.05 Å. Ti is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ti-O bond lengths are 1.93 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Pr, one Zr, and one Ti atom.
